candidates.description: This vector represents typographical or sub-word fragments starting with the letters "Am" or "Arm".
This feature vector represents word fragments and suffixes related to the concept of ability, capability, or derivation from the root "able."
This vector represents the character sequence 'ent' and words or subwords containing this root.
This vector represents social groups, political factions, and interpersonal or intergroup tensions.
These tokens represent common French adverbs and conjunctive adverbs used to express modification, time, degree, or logical connection.
This vector represents a collection of common French word roots, suffixes, and morphological fragments.
This feature vector activates on words related to public violence, slaughter, or large-scale humanitarian and social stress.
This vector represents administrative and territorial subdivisions of land, such as provinces, districts, and municipalities.
This vector represents French verb suffixes and words ending in the "-end" or "-and" phonetic sound, particularly centered around forms of the root verb "-prendre" and "-rendre".
This vector represents the prefix "aut-" in various French and English words.
